headline: ConocoPhillips (COP) Following Pelto Island Reef Project Is The Stock A Bargain
summary: Why the Pelto Island reef project matters for ConocoPhillips stock ConocoPhillips (COP) is in focus after CCA Louisiana highlighted a major habitat restoration at Pelto Island in Lake Pelto, where the company is lead partner and landowner through a key subsidiary. The project expands the historic Pelto Island footprint and adds 650 Natrx reef modules to support speckled trout and redfish habitat.
